text:
A student is doing an experiment with radioactive materials.
Which piece of advice is not useful?
A
Do not spend too long doing the experiment.
B
Keep any material not being used at a distance.
C
Take frequent sips of water.
D
Wear gloves.

options.label: A
options.text: Do not spend too long doing the experiment.

options.label: B
options.text: Keep any material not being used at a distance.
